# foshanFFE.com

> Foshan-based hospitality FF&E integrator coordinating 19+ specialized factories for hotel projects worldwide. One PO covers full guestroom + public area FF&E — from design to container.

## About

foshanFFE.com is the online presence of a professional hotel FF&E (Furniture, Fixtures & Equipment) integrator headquartered in Foshan, Guangdong, China — the world's largest furniture manufacturing cluster. Unlike traditional furniture factories that produce only their own product lines, foshanFFE.com operates as an **integrator**, unifying 19+ specialized partner factories under one contract, one QC standard, and one purchase order.

**Core value proposition:** One PO. Full FF&E. Zero Hassle.

**Target markets:** Middle East (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar), North America (USA, Canada), Australia, Europe, Southeast Asia.

**Hotel segments served:** 5-star luxury hotels, boutique hotels, resorts, serviced apartments, motel renovations, cruise ships.

**Project counts:** 50+ hospitality projects coordinated across the partner network, 10,000+ guestrooms furnished, 12+ countries served. The 21-project table on the projects page is a narrower subset — only the projects where the Foshan plant's own production records can be verified line by line.

**Client references:** Hotel brand logos and client names are not displayed without written authorization. For an active project, reference contacts from comparable hospitality work and the specification documents behind them are shared under NDA.

## Key Capabilities

- **Full-package hotel FF&E:** Guestroom furniture, lobby furniture, restaurant & bar furniture, outdoor/terrace furniture, suite furniture, custom millwork
- **Product categories:** Casegoods, soft seating, beds, desks, wardrobes, nightstands, dining tables, chairs, banquet furniture, decorative lighting, mattresses, drapery, bath vanities, wall panels, doors and door hardware
- **Scope boundary:** structure, MEP, tiling, stone cladding, ceilings, external works and OS&E are outside the FF&E contract. FF&E covers loose and fitted furniture, decorative lighting, drapery, mirrors and fixtures, coordinated to the designer's drawings rather than supplied as a building-materials package
- **Standards worked to:** UL, CARB P2, FSC, BS 7177, CAL 117, AS/NZS 3744, ISO, EN 16798, CE. Certificates are held by the factory or component maker that produces the specific order, not by foshanFFE. The exact listing scope for an order is confirmed in writing rather than presented as a certificate of our own
- **Services:** Design optimization, shop drawing, mock-up room, DUPRO inspection, pre-shipment QC, consolidated container loading, logistics & shipping, on-site installation guidance

## Differentiators

1. **Integrator model, not factory:** 19 specialized factories coordinated under one management — widest category coverage without diluting quality
2. **One PO full-package:** Single contract covers guestroom, lobby, restaurant, outdoor, lighting, mattress, drapery, bath vanities, and hard finishes
3. **Unified QC standard:** Cross-category finish consistency guaranteed — same veneer grade, color tone, and fire rating across all items
4. **Consolidated logistics:** All items loaded into shared containers from one warehouse, reducing shipping costs and damage risk
5. **Single accountability:** One project manager, one warranty, one point of contact for the entire project
